Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask and the spreadsheet. We can cover this end-to-end. Initial responses inline below, and I've attached a short mutual action plan (redwood-map-v1.pdf) to scope responsibilities.

High-level evidence Azure expects for a private offer:
- Tenant proof that the offer hits an authenticated endpoint (SSO/OIDC or service principal)
- ARM templates or SaaS connector proof for onboarding (sample JSON is fine)
- Endpoint smoke test IP allowlist and a test account with minimal creds
- Logging/audit expectations (retention, minimal event set)

Redwood-specific notes:
- For co-sell we ask that the offer manifest include a coSellEnabled flag and SKU metadata for unit economics (we'll help map)
- We prefer an ARM sample and a lightweight health-check endpoint that returns JSON {status:ok, version:semver}
- For identity, service principal evidence + delegated consent screenshots are sufficient for the initial gate; SOC2 artifacts may follow later for formal co-sell approvals

Next steps we recommend:
1) NebulaOps to provide sample ARM template + one test tenant (read-only creds)
2) Redwood will run a smoke test and produce a short evidence pack for the portal
3) Joint technical validation call (30 min) to walk publishing flow and DocuSign for any commercial attachments

I proposed a few slots in the attached MAP. If you can send the sandbox details, we'll queue the smoke test.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Partner Enablement, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-map-v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
